verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that an llms.txt file is served (HTTP 200) on developers.cloudflare.com, the docs host for Realtime, and that a machine-readable openapi.json is available. However, the llms.txt is Cloudflare-wide, its content is truncated so Realtime coverage is not shown, and the per-page markdown variant for the Realtime SFU docs returned 404. Missing for 10: confirmed Realtime-specific entries in llms.txt, working markdown versions of Realtime doc pages, any first-party documentation describing agent-oriented docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt # Cloudflare Developer Documentation
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
